turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um, what brings you in today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Hi, I just came in uh, I just had this sudden, just this morning after I woke up, this sudden shortness of breath and like each time I take a deep breath I'm getting this chest pain.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and this just started this morning, you said?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Were you absolutely fine last night?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I didn't have any trouble last night.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see, I see, okay. Um, any other, does the chest pain only occur when you're taking a deep breath in?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, mainly it's during that time.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, um, have you had any other symptoms such as a headache or cough, or runny nose, congestion, sore throat?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, no. No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And changes in your bowel movement? Any pain in your belly?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any urinary symptoms?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any um, any pain in your legs?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, I did notice last, last night and for the last few days that my right calf like, just feels um, painful and it seems a bit more swollen.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um, was there anything that you were doing a couple of days ago? Any, say, any flights or periods um, where you might be sitting still or lying still for awhile? Any surgeries, anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I was, I was just discharged from the hospital um, last week after a hip surgery.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um, okay. Were you moving around at home after the hip surgery?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um not, not really. Like I was, I was told I should move around a bit, but it's been quite hard.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um, alright, and do you have any medical conditions that you've been diagnosed with?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes, I have uh, high blood pressure, and um, I also have this thing like, like varicose veins.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um, do you take any medications?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I, I take this medication called um, lisinopril.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And any new medications that were started after your hospital stay?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, no, they gave me like some pain medications I seem to, uh, um I got hydromorphone medication. I've been trying to stay away from it though, just taking Tylenol instead.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Is your pain controlled well with Tylenol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I tried to suck it up. I just don't wanna go on those other medications. I've heard like, you can get addicted to them.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, that's fair, that's a fair point. But it's also, I guess it's important that you move around at home. Um, so maybe try to, maybe we can increase your Tylenol dose, or maybe um, see if there's another pain med that you can be started on if you're not interested in opioids, just to make sure that you're moving around 'cause that's very important. At the hospital, did you receive an injection in your, in your tummy.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: An injection in my tummy, um.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Every day, once a day?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I think so, yeah I did.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, okay. Um, alright. And do you have any allergies?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no allergies.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, um, and who do you live with?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I live alone. Yeah, right now I live alone in an apartment.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Were you discharged with any support?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I do have a nurse coming in, like every, everyday, but I don't, they, they didn't come like yesterday.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, okay. Um, and do you smoke, or did you ever smoke in the past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I used to smoke in, probably in my 20s and 30s, but then I stopped when I had kids and stuff.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you drink alcohol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, yeah, probably uh, a glass, once or twice um, every couple days.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um, and sorry. just going back, how much did you smoke in your 20s and 30s and for how many years?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Probably smoked for, probably, 15, 15 years, probably like, like half a pack a day.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright um, and do you consume any marijuana or any recreational drugs?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, alright. Well given your symptoms, um, with the, with the swelling and the pain in the right calf and the difficulties breathing, it's very likely that you have um, and your recent hospitalization and hip injury, um it sounds like you might have something called, or pulmonary embolism, basically, which is a blood clot inside your lungs, and so we'll do a scan of your lungs to see what's going on. We'll also do an ultrasound of your leg, and then um, we might have to treat, uh, this with blood thinners. And we definitely have to hospitalize you, and we'll be measuring your vitals and seeing if you need any oxygen to help you out.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Okay, I'll be, I'll be here for a while then?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Well, we'll keep you for a bit, at least the next couple of days until your, your breathing gets better. And you've, you've been started on anti, on blood thinners.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Okay.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And we can be sure that you're, you're doing okay, we'll also continuously monitor your vital signs um, to make sure that you're doing well, and then we'll make sure that you're discharged. We will also get you some physiotherapy here while in the hospital to help you um, mobilize better when you get home. Um, and we'll also do a COVID swab just in case. Did you have any exposures to anyone in the past couple of days before you came, at home, after you came home?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I've been just at home, just the nurse.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see, I see. Okay, well, we'll do a COVID swab just in case and go from there. Do you have any questions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No um, yeah, that, that sounds good.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, great.
